summary: Executed end-to-end frontend testing of the additive Buyer Marketplace & Service Ordering System (frontend-only, localStorage). All critical flows work: /services renders 41 cards (33 in main grid + 4 popular + 4 recommended), filters/sort/clear behave correctly, ServiceDetails hides direct contact (no phone/whatsapp/telegram inside the details/seller/price panels — only category/footer nav mentions of 'Telegram Services' & 'WhatsApp Services' which are category names, not contact fields), guest Buy Now redirects to /login (protected route enforced), signup flow works and routes to /dashboard/{role}, checkout creates an order, /orders/success renders with order info + notification pushed, buyer sees order in My Orders/Active with correct stats, cancel moves it to Cancelled, seller Accept → Accepted (payment=paid) and Mark as delivered → Completed all worked, buyer Leave review modal + star-rating-5 + textarea + submit worked, admin panel has all 4 tabs (orders/payments/reviews/services) with status/set-processing/mark-paid/refund/hide/remove buttons present and clickable, and localStorage persistence confirmed after navigation. AccountMenu (present on BuyerOrders/SellerOrders/Messages/Notifications/MyAccount) contains new links. Existing routes /, /marketplace, /find-freelancers, /login unchanged.

issues: LiveSupportWidget + AuthAccessWidget in bottom-right can overlap with sticky right-column content on some viewports; consider z-index/margin review.

critical_code_review_comments: Rating filter 4.5 on /services returned 33/33 items (no reduction). Not a bug per se — seed data is uniformly high-rated (>=4.5) — but consider adding lower-rated seed rows so the rating filter chip's effect is observable.
Search 'logo' returns 0 (correct given no matching titles/tags in seed data); consider expanding seed data or making the empty state more informative.

AccountMenu is rendered as an in-page NavLink strip on specific pages (BuyerOrders/SellerOrders/Messages/Notifications/MyAccount) rather than as a Header dropdown. It is NOT rendered on /profile or /dashboard/{role}. If the intent was a global menu accessible from anywhere, consider adding it (or the new links) to the Header/My Account dropdown as well.

ServiceDetails/Marketplace pages contain the strings 'Telegram Services' and 'WhatsApp Services' inside the Footer's category list — these are category names, not direct contact CTAs, so the privacy requirement is satisfied. Flagging so future testing agents don't misinterpret.
MarketplaceServiceCard exposes both service-card-<id> and service-view-details-<id> testids — good coverage.
test_credentials: Fresh users created via /signup during test run (tb<timestamp>@example.com / Password123!). localStorage-backed.
seed_data_creation: Signed up ephemeral test users; placed 2 orders that were accepted+completed+reviewed on those users' localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All targeted flows validated end-to-end via public URL. Note: (1) AccountMenu is a page-embedded component, not a header dropdown — validate on /dashboard/buyer-orders. (2) The Footer contains category links named 'Telegram Services' / 'WhatsApp Services' — do NOT flag as privacy violation; verify the RIGHT-column price/seller panels on /services/:id instead (they contain no phone/whatsapp/telegram). (3) All persistence is via localStorage — different browser sessions won't share data.
